prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1242; do not mention it.)
text:
This office represents our client in connection with injuries sustained in a side-impact collision at a signalized intersection. Our client was struck by a vehicle insured under your policy and has suffered injuries that are still being evaluated by treating providers. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request that you confirm in writing the bodily injury liability limits available under the policy covering the at-fault driver, along with any other coverage that may apply to this loss. Please also provide the name of the adjuster assigned to the claim.

We further ask that your insured and your company preserve all evidence relating to the collision. This includes vehicle data and event recorder information, photographs, dashcam or surveillance footage, repair estimates, claim file notes, recorded statements, and any communications with the insured or other parties. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal of such materials until this matter is resolved.

Please acknowledge receipt of this letter within fourteen days.
